name: Tourist/Business Visa and Visa on Arrival

requirements.blocker_text: Visa application (or, exceptionally, an Emergency Entry Visa/Visa on Arrival) must be addressed to the Comptroller-General of Immigration, stating country of origin, arrival date, stay duration, purpose, itinerary, and lodging.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a visa through a Ghanaian mission, or an Emergency Entry Visa on arrival where eligible.

evidence_required.document: Application letter to the Comptroller-General of Immigration
Bank statement, flight itinerary, hotel reservation (personal visits)
Certificate of incorporation, tax clearance certificate (business visits)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service -- Visa on Arrival/Emergency Entry Visa: exempts ECOWAS member states, select African countries, diplomatic/service passport holders from select countries, and airside transit passengers; standard applications addressed to the Comptroller-General of Immigration in Accra; business track requires certificate to commence business, incorporation certificate, company code, tax clearance; personal track requires bank statement, flight itinerary, hotel reservation

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ghana). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Ghana Immigration Service). ECOWAS member-state nationals are visa-exempt, consistent with the regional-bloc preferences seen elsewhere in this dataset (compare Kenya/EAC, Uganda/EAC). GENUINE GAP, NOT FABRICATED: neither visa validity/stay length nor fees were published on the government's own pages retrieved in this build -- flagged for follow-up rather than guessed at.
